quests.title: They Who Hear the Sea

dialogue.t: Found it! Treasure, treasure... Wonder what'll we find inside...
Eh? There's a lock on it. And it's coded, too... Looks like we'll need the code to open it...

dialogue.sit: We can just shatter it, can't we?
Looks like we'll have to find a way to unlock it.

dialogue.t: Wait! What will happen if the stuff inside breaks as well?
Let's find a way to unlock it instead, shall we?
But since this chest contains "family heirlooms" and is locked using a code...
That's gotta mean that the person who locked it thinks that the code they left behind is easy enough to remember.
Looks like our only chance are those conches that store sounds.
Let's listen to the sounds inside those conches again. Let's hope that they can give us some clues about the code...
(You must enter the correct code to open this chest. What number do you wish to enter in the first position?)
(You must enter the correct code to open this chest. What number do you wish to enter in the second position?)
(You must enter the correct code to open this chest. What number do you wish to enter in the third position?)
(You must enter the correct code to open this chest. What number do you wish to enter in the fourth position?)
(You attempt to open the coded lock...)
It opened! Let's have a look at what's inside!
Aw, it didn't open... Looks like we didn't enter the correct code...
Let's listen carefully to the sounds that the conches make. Maybe those'll give us some clues.

quests.description: You discover a strange conch shell on Twinning Isle in the Golden Apple Archipelago. The sounds that come from within seem to hint at something…
